svg.title: SAMI broadcast evaluation on GB200
svg.desc: (a) Copy-engine prototype: algorithm bandwidth of SAMI and owner-direct (single-port) multicast against the group size; (b) replication kernel bandwidth against copy SMs per GPU; (c) one broadcast at a time, slowest rank: SAMI against tuned ncclBroadcast; (d) time increase when four experts are copied beside the shared expert.
